nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/user_turns_desktop.md — the desktop half of the corpus before merge: 127 verbatim human turns from 2026-05-14, same format as user_turns_all.md, with user_turns_desktop.jsonl as its machine-readable twin

The desktop half is a strict subset of the merged corpus and carries everything before 07-06 that survives as chat — 05-14, 05-15, 05-27, 05-28, 06-27, 06-30, 07-01, 07-02 and 07-12. It was extracted in a separate pass from transcripts copied to OneDrive on 08-03 and then concatenated, so its own accounting stands alone: 824 user-role records seen, 697 rejected by a named rule, 0 duplicates collapsed, 127 kept. Its false-negative audit differs in method from the laptop's — no harness_template reject exists, the 620 tool_result rejects provably carry zero characters of human text, and all 77 remaining rejects were read individually
